name: Ethyl linalool
description: Ethyl linalool (CAS 10339-55-6 ) is a terpenol alcohol used as a fragrance ingredient and flavoring agent across personal care and industrial formulations. It delivers a fresh, floral-woody scent profile that positions it as a functional building block in fragrance compounding. In personal care, this compound is incorporated into fine fragrances, body lotions, shampoos, and shower gels where a clean floral character is required. Coatings and printing ink formulators use it as a fragrance modifier to mask solvent odors. This ingredient helps to improve the sensory profile of finished products across various industrial sectors. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers include it in scented or odor-corrected formulations where low-intensity, lasting fragrance retention is a specification requirement. As a flavoring agent, it contributes nuance to food and beverage applications where subtle floral-citrus notes are targeted. The chemical structure allows for excellent stability in a wide range of aqueous and oil-based systems used in manufacturing. The product is supplied as a clear liquid, typically at high purity levels suited to fragrance and flavor end uses. Standard commercial grades align with fragrance industry purity benchmarks to ensure consistent performance in delicate scent profiles. Food-grade material is available to meet flavor application requirements and regulatory compliance. Packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities depending on volume requirements, ensuring flexible logistics for global chemical distribution networks.
